name: Toyama

flag.description: A green emblem on a white field: the hiragana と (to) set in the peaks of Mount Tateyama.
flag.symbolism: と, the first sound of Toyama, stands in the middle of Mount Tateyama, for a prefecture leaping toward the sky.

hook: Toyama's green on white is と (to) inside the Tateyama peaks: Toyama means "rich mountain".
trivia: The Tateyama Kurobe Alpine Route runs between walls of snow up to about 20 m high each spring.
Until 1989 the flag was a gold emblem on green; it then became the green-on-white flag of today.
